card.name: News reports of disasters and violence
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation inside news reports of riots, battles, fires, earthquakes or tsunamis, often near a place and date, such as 'in Lhasa on March 14'.

modes.label: Place and date of unrest
modes.description: Small words and digits in the place-and-date phrase after an act of violence.

modes.label: Disaster or conflict scene
modes.description: Words describing a battle, a blocked road or a quake and tsunami in a news story.
modes.example: where a<< battle>> between the government and rebels is raging.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words about aftermath and casualties, though the output effect is mixed and unclear.
card.plain: It lights up in news stories about riots, fighting and natural disasters, on the small words around places and dates.
